# `set_image_save_path`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Select which storage backend (internal flash, SD card or USB disk) new images are saved to.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcab90, SetCurStorageType @0x3159e0 (64-bit build) |

The parameter is a storage name, not a filesystem path. The name is matched case-insensitively and exactly. On models with internal eMMC the names map emmc, sd, udisk; on other models sd and udisk are accepted (sd takes the internal slot). An empty or unrecognised name is rejected with 109. Selecting the storage already in force succeeds before any connectivity check. Otherwise the new storage must be present and mounted; the current type is updated, the selected image path is copied to the global image directory and the configuration is written. No directory is created from the supplied string. No wait or timeout is shown.

Side effects: Changes the current storage type, the global image directory and the stored configuration when the selection changes.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_image_save_path"`. [READ] |
| `params` | string | yes | - | Storage name: emmc (models with internal eMMC only), sd or udisk, matched case-insensitively. The params member is a bare string, not an object; array, object, null or absence is rejected with 105. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | params absent, null, or not a string | `expected string param` |
| 109 | Empty or unrecognised storage name | `unexpected param` |
| 318 | Newly selected storage has no descriptor or is not in the mounted state | `device not connected` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

No other ordinary failure is reachable inside the storage setter.

## Example

Request, select-usb-disk:

```json
{"id":91,"method":"set_image_save_path","params":"udisk"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_image_save_path","result":0,"code":0,"id":91}
```

Reply, not-mounted:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_image_save_path","error":"device not connected","code":318,"id":92}
```
